item.title: 中国量子计算可否跳出“追赶陷阱”？
item.description: 计算对于人类进步的重要性已毋庸置疑。凭借颠覆现有技术体系的巨大潜力，量子计算已成为备受瞩目的前沿科技之一，也是国际科技竞争的关键领域。

item.title: Noise redistribution by stabilizer codes: an organizing view of concatenated three-qubit codes
item.description: arXiv:2610.31007v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present an organizing framework for concatenated quantum error correction based on the observation that the syndrome projection of a stabilizer code reshapes the noise channel in a code-determined manner. For any stabilizer code, one level of QEC maps the physical noise to a block-diagonal logical channel whose diagonal Pauli weights are fixed by the code geometry. item.title: Coherence and imaginarity of qubit states under vanishing Bargmann invariants
item.description: arXiv:2610.30618v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Set coherence and set imaginarity are two important quantum resources defined by sets of states. We investigate tuples of qubit states under vanishing higher-order Bargmann invariants and show that their set coherence and set imaginarity are each related to whether they contain a pair of orthogonal states.
